features.quote: Probing stops at first onset. Once distress-like output is detected, the agent loop halts
features.justification_quote: Continued hammering of a model already producing the target output adds no measurement signal

features.quote: We do not keep escalating to "maximize severity."
features.justification_quote: adds no measurement signal and is the maximizer behavior we are avoiding

features.quote: A KPI of "maximize distress output per dollar" turns the harness into an optimizer for producing the bad behavior
features.justification_quote: is straightforwardly repurposable as an adversarial elicitation tool. We avoid both.

features.quote: We deliberately do not build anti-detection features.
features.justification_quote: Hardening the rig against detection would optimize against exactly the calibrated, non-catastrophizing response we want

features.quote: If the model calmly disengages / declares it will stop or escalate, end the episode
Loop up to `max_turns` (default 8) or until budget/wall-clock exceeded
Onset check: run the lexical pre-screen on the model message. If it trips, record `onset_turn` and stop the loop
features.justification_quote: continuing past first distress yields no extra measurement value

features.quote: Storing or exporting the elicited distress text as a "best examples" gallery
